brief:
Israel has prevented an international delegation including British politicians from entering the West Bank, The Guardian reported. The group intended to meet Palestinian children, farmers, and civil leaders affected by escalating violence from Israeli forces.

The denial marks the latest restriction on foreign access to Palestinian territories. Details on the specific politicians involved and stated justifications for the barring were not disclosed.

title: Israel bars British politicians from West Bank visit
